name: Semrush
description: Semrush is a digital marketing platform for SEO, content, and competitive research, combining keyword research, site auditing, backlink analysis, and AI visibility tracking to help brands grow and measure visibility across digital channels.
best_for: Positioned for solopreneurs, freelancers, small teams, agencies, mid-market companies, and enterprises across industries like SaaS, e-commerce, healthcare, and professional services.
features: Keyword research across a database of billions of keywords
Site audit and technical SEO health analysis
Competitor and backlink analysis with rank tracking across 142 geo databases
AI visibility tracking that monitors brand mentions across LLM prompts
PPC and advertising tools for Google and Meta
Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization
